title: Ground-truth manifest of attack episodes (detection quality tests, test plan 3.6)

dataset.description: Dataset ID from the test plan (section 5), e.g. SIM-SCEN or PCAP-SET/<file>.

seed.description: Simulator seed, so the run can be reproduced. Null for files.

created_at.description: Epoch seconds when the manifest was written.

notes.description: Free text, e.g. how a hand-written manifest was checked (second person).

episode_id.description: Unique inside the manifest, e.g. port_scan-003.

class.description: The five scenarios of spec 5. Normal traffic is everything that is not inside an episode.

attackers.description: Source IPs or CIDR networks (DDoS with many sources).

start.description: Flow time (ts_start, epoch seconds) of the first attack flow. Not the ingestion time: replayed PCAPs keep their original timestamps.

end.description: Flow time (ts_start) of the last attack flow.

params.description: How the episode was generated, e.g. {ports: 300, rate_per_s: 50, variant: weak}. Used in the error analysis.
